A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Make it clear.
Make it usable.

I want to build digital products people can use with confidence. I’m interested in the details that make a task easier: a clear label, a useful filter, or a chance to check an order before paying.

I’m now pursuing an M.S. in Graphic Information Technology at ASU, with graduation expected in May 2027. I’m continuing to develop my ability to connect design decisions with what people need to do.

I earned my B.S. in Graphic Information Technology with a UX focus at Arizona State University in May 2025. My projects span user flows, interface design, usability testing, accessibility reviews, and front-end development. I’m looking for an early-career UX or product design role where I can contribute these skills and keep learning from an experienced team.
